persona: t-shirt shop buyer deciding what sells

designs.why: Reads from 3 m as a striking mountain: bright moonlit flank, graphic stars, lamp dots give a story. Engraving look is premium and one-ink friendly. Weak spots: the shadowed north face is murky and dashed at distance, the right-edge fringe looks ragged/glitchy, and the bottom horizontal lines feel like a cut-off base rather than a deliberate vignette. Subject is niche (Eiger fans) but climbers/hikers will pay $50.
designs.fix: Clean up the right-flank edge fringe and the bottom line fade so the vignette feels deliberate and smooth, and strengthen the north face tone so the silhouette and face read more clearly from a distance.
